name: Honda Monkey 125
engine: 124 cc air-cooled SOHC single, fuel injected
intro: Honda's modern mini bike. Very simple. Mostly routine service and a reflector recall on early bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Many 2020-2021 Monkeys were in recall 21V382 because the rear reflector may not be bright enough.
A-002.reason: A dim reflector makes the bike harder to see at night. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Rear reflector lens may not be bright enough.
